title: How I spend 2k/day on facebook ads
description: How I spend 2k/day on facebook ads
transcript: Let's go to the winning campaigns. So these are gonna be what I call my scaling campaigns, okay? And these are typically two of them, because remember, we have one for images and one for videos, okay? And what I do here is I actually run campaign budget optimizations on these. So instead of having individual assets, and I'm saying it's a hundred dollars a day, I'm saying at the campaign level, I want to be spending, let's say, minimum, $1,000 a day for the images 1 and $1,000 a day for the video one. And so now I'm spending $2,000 a day. And let's say I have a 4 x return on my ad spend. That means I'm gonna be making $8,000 back in revenue over whatever my sales cycle length is.
